scope: One realism test only. Full-minute production is not authorized.
prompt: A single eight-second photorealistic cinematic scene for ASCEND, a career preparation and talent fulfillment network. The story is a young adult learning to handle actual work with thoughtful support. Two believable Indian adults: a 23-year-old woman graduate in understated smart casual clothing, and a 40-year-old female workplace mentor. Begin at human eye level just behind the student's shoulder in a contemporary customer operations team workspace with soft natural daylight, restrained teal and emerald accents. The student is working through a realistic delayed-delivery customer scenario on a laptop. At 0–3 seconds she studies the laptop and a short paper status note, thoughtfully checks the information, and makes one small deliberate keyboard action. At 3–6 seconds she turns slightly toward the mentor seated alongside her and points to the relevant part of her handwritten action plan, explaining her proposed next step with a restrained natural gesture. The mentor listens attentively and points once to a next-action line, offering constructive guidance. At 6–8 seconds the student gives a small understanding nod and returns to her work with quiet confidence. The emotional focus is care, agency, practical judgement, and growing capability, never a graduation ceremony, job offer, victory celebration or testimonial. A continuous slow straight FORWARD dolly of about one metre toward the people and their work, no orbit, no circular movement, no pan around furniture, no overhead shot, no pullback, no cuts. Real physical depth and parallax, realistic skin pores, natural facial expressions, anatomically correct hands with restrained movements, fabric texture, soft indirect light and realistic reflections. The camera focuses on people doing the work, with furniture secondary and out of focus. Screen content remains naturally out of focus and oblique: no invented readable interface or branding. No text overlays, no subtitles, no logos, no numbers, no watermarks, no charts or scores, no holograms, no floating cards. No talking to the camera. Premium photorealistic 3D cinematic realism, visually indistinguishable from natural live-action footage, not cartoons, not plastic characters. Silent; no music or dialogue audio.
